auth.name: Name
auth.verify_email_notice: Thanks for signing up! Before getting started, could you verify your email address by clicking on the link we just emailed to you? If you didn't receive the email, we will gladly send you another.
auth.verification_link_sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.
auth.forgot_password_notice: Forgot your password? No problem. Just let us know your email address and we will email you a password reset link that will allow you to choose a new one.
auth.confirm_password_notice: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.

profile.title: Profile
profile.info_body: Update your account's profile information and email address.
profile.resend_verification_link: Click here to re-send the verification email.
profile.verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
profile.password_body: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
profile.delete_body: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Before deleting your account, please download any data or information that you wish to retain.
profile.delete_confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
profile.delete_confirm_body: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.

users.title: Users
users.password_hint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
users.username_hint: Any language, spaces allowed — e.g. محمد مرقة. No email needed.
users.delete_keeps_history: They will no longer be able to log in and will disappear from the lists; their orders, payments and staff account stay as they are. Continue?

languages.title: Languages
languages.code_locked_hint: The code can't be changed after creation since translated content is keyed to it.
languages.name: Administrative Name

feedback.hint: Free-form notes customers leave about the cafe from the menu page.

categories.title: Categories
categories.menu_locked_hint: The menu can't be changed after creation. Delete and recreate this section under a different menu instead.
categories.station_hint: Which printer station handles items in this category by default. A product can override this.
categories.image_hint: Shown as the category's picture on the customer menu — a square photo works best.
categories.drag_hint: Drag ⋮⋮ to order categories — a category can only move among its siblings, not to a different parent.

tags.icon_hint: One emoji, shown next to the tag (e.g. 🌶️ Spicy, 🌱 Vegan).

services.icon_hint: One emoji, shown next to the service (e.g. 🔔 Call Waiter, 🧾 Bill).
services.image_hint: Shown large on the waiter's alert popup and confirmation page — optional, falls back to the icon above if left blank.
services.color_hint: Used to color-code this service's alerts so different requests don't all look the same. Leave blank to auto-assign one.
services.hint: Every active service appears as a request option on the customer menu's "Call Waiter" sheet — requesting one notifies the waiter in real time, same as calling a waiter today.

service_charges.hint: Lines added to a bill that nobody cooks — a seat held past two hours, a table service charge, corkage. They never appear on the customer menu and never print in the kitchen; the till or an admin adds one to a table when it applies.
service_charges.name_hint: The wording the customer will read on the bill.
service_charges.amount_hint: The suggested price. It can still be changed on the bill when adding it.

modifier_groups.drag_to_reorder: Drag ⋮⋮ to reorder — this is the order the customer sees
modifier_groups.is_variation_hint: Prices here are the product price itself, not added on top of a base. The customer must pick exactly one, and the menu card shows the highest price in the group.

products.title: Products
products.menus_hint: Which menus/sections include this product. Add or remove it from the Menu Builder — a product can belong to several menus at different prices.
products.station_placeholder: Leave blank to use the category's station
products.station_hint: Overrides the category's default kitchen printer station for this product only.
products.prep_time_hint: Estimated time to prepare this item. Leave blank to hide it on the menu.
products.category_hint: Pick the sections this product appears in. Sub-sections are indented under their parent.
products.variations_hint: Attach an option group (e.g. Size, Extras) and, if needed, give this specific product its own price for one of its choices — otherwise it uses the group's default price.
products.variations_none: No option groups yet. Create one under Modifier Groups first.
products.unavailable_globally: Turned off for every product (edit the group to change this).
products.category_removal_warning: The product will be removed from: {names} — along with its order and any section-specific price there.
products.drag_hint: Drag ⋮⋮ to order products — this is the order they appear in.
products.reorder_disabled_by_filter: Clear the filters to reorder by dragging.
products.reorder_needs_full_list: Reordering is not possible while filtered — clear the filters first.
products.reorder_disabled_by_paging: Reordering needs the whole list on one page

menus.title: Menus
menus.builder_hint: Drag sections and products to reorder them. Prices are per-menu overrides — leave blank to use the product's default price.
menus.days_of_week_hint: Leave all unselected to show on every day.
menus.no_items: No products in this section yet.
menus.picker_hint: Search, filter by tag, and pick as many products as you like — they are added in one go.
menus.section_active_hint: An inactive section is hidden from customers along with everything in it.
menus.product_inactive_hint: This product is switched off globally, so it does not appear on the menu even though the line is active.
menus.no_sections: This menu has no sections yet. Add one to start placing products.
menus.remove_section_with_items: This will also remove {count} product(s) from the menu. Are you sure?
menus.section_name_locale_hint: Enter the name in {language} — other languages can be filled in later from the section page.
menus.drag_hint: Drag ⋮⋮ to order menus — this is the order the customer sees.

printers.station_hint: Must match a category's or product's station exactly for tickets to route here.
printers.usb_hint: 4-digit hex codes from "lsusb" (e.g. Bus 003 Device 014: ID 154f:1001 → vendor 154f, product 1001).
printers.usb_detect_hint: Fills in the vendor/product ID for you — needs the printer plugged into this computer, and Chrome or Edge.
printers.usb_detect_unsupported: This browser can't detect USB devices — open this page in Chrome or Edge on the computer the printer is plugged into, or enter the IDs manually below.
printers.usb_detect_error: Couldn't read that device. Enter the vendor/product ID manually below.
printers.usb_unsupported_server: This install cannot drive USB printers directly (the bundled PHP has no FFI extension). Instead choose "Windows printer (shared)" above — it works with the same USB printer, through the Windows spooler.
printers.manual_only_notice: Tickets that failed while a printer was down stay here and are never printed automatically when it returns — press Reprint for the ones you still want.
printers.no_categories: No sections route to this printer — nothing will ever reach it.
printers.alert_line: {printer} is offline — {count} item(s) from order {order} did not print.
printers.discover_none: No printers found on this network. Check the printer is switched on and on the same network.
printers.uncovered_body: These stations exist on the menu with no active printer: {stations} — their items will not reach any kitchen.
printers.confirm_cancel: Cancel this job? It will not print, and stays on the record.
printers.confirm_cancel_all: Cancel every unprinted job shown? They stay on the record and will not print.

tables.title: Tables
tables.label: Label
tables.click_hint: Click a table to see its details
tables.drag_hint: Drag tables to arrange them like your dining room
tables.move_merge_confirm: Table {label} already has a running order. Move this order there and merge it with the existing one?
tables.keyboard_hint: Or focus a table and nudge it with the arrow keys
tables.snap_alt_hint: Hold Alt while dragging to place a table freely

staff.service_charge_hint: Added as a line on the bill and never printed in the kitchen. Its price can still be changed from Edit bill.
staff.payment_reference_placeholder: Number from the card terminal — optional
staff.card_not_in_drawer: A card payment does not open the drawer and is not counted in the cash balance.
staff.edit_bill_hint: Change a quantity or a price, or remove a line — each edit saves as you go.
staff.edit_bill_kitchen_warning: The kitchen already has this ticket — an edit here changes the bill only, and the printed slip will not say so.
staff.edit_bill_invalid: Enter a price of zero or more and a quantity of one or more.
staff.edit_bill_closed_warning: This bill is already closed — the recorded total will change, but what was collected will not. The edit is logged against your account.
staff.pay_partially: Part payment — take this and leave the rest owing

waiter.title: Orders
waiter.call_from_table: Table {table} is asking for a waiter
waiter.call_generic: A customer is asking for a waiter
waiter.sound_blocked: 🔔 The browser is blocking sound — tap here to enable service alerts

menu.cart_items_gone: These items are no longer available and were removed from your basket: {items}
menu.cart_repriced: Prices were updated for some items in your basket: {items}
menu.edit_until_confirmed: You can change what you ordered until the waiter confirms it.
menu.feedback_subtitle: Anything about your visit — we read every note.
menu.locked_after_confirm: Your order is confirmed — ask the waiter if you need to change anything.
menu.order_here_subtitle: No need to wait for a waiter — pick what you like and send your order straight to our team.
menu.quick_add_hint: {count} result(s) — press Enter to add the first
menu.quick_add_placeholder: Type a dish name… ↑↓ to move, Enter to add
menu.scan_qr_required: Table not detected. Please scan the QR code on your table to order.
menu.services_subtitle: Pick what you need — the waiter is notified right away.
menu.shared_table_hint: Everyone at this table can add from their own phone — you all see the same bill.
menu.title: Menu
menu.waiter_on_the_way: A waiter is on the way

orders.cancel_locked: Order confirmed — only a manager can cancel it
orders.cancel_confirm: Cancel the order on table {table}? The table will be cleared and nothing will be charged for it.

settings.contact_hint: These links appear at the bottom of the customer menu. You can enter a full URL or just the username.
settings.wifi_hint: Printed as a scannable Wi-Fi QR code next to each table's menu QR — leave blank to skip it.
settings.receipt_footer_hint: Shown at the bottom of the printed cashier receipt. You can enter more than one line. Leave blank to use the default ("Thank you for your visit!").
settings.business_day_hint: The hour the trading day begins. If you close at 3am, set it to 06:00 — everything sold before that hour counts towards the previous day in the cash box, the reports and the orders screen. 00:00 means the plain calendar day.
settings.cashbox_float_hint: What the cash box starts with every day, automatically (the change in the drawer). When you close the day, leave this amount in the drawer and take the rest — there is nothing to open in the morning.
settings.print_wifi_qr_hint: Enter a network name and save to print a Wi-Fi sign.

welcome.tagline: A multilingual restaurant management system, Arabic first.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.deductions_note: Card takings, staff deductions and bill discounts are shown for information only and are not part of the drawer balance — none of them puts cash in it or takes cash out of it.
accounting.counted_hint: Enter what is physically there — the system works out the rest.
accounting.leave_float_hint: After closing, leave {amount} in the drawer and take the rest — tomorrow opens on it automatically.
accounting.confirm_reopen: Reopening a closed day allows its figures to be changed. Are you sure?
accounting.paid_from_cash_hint: Untick if it was paid by bank transfer or any other way that does not touch the drawer.
accounting.deduction_hint: Leave at zero if the absence was not charged for.
accounting.time_hint: Leave a time empty for the whole day. The time applies to sales and payments only — expenses, absences and cash-box closings are recorded by day, with no clock reading.
accounting.truncated_range: Range too long — only the first 190 days are shown.
accounting.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this?
accounting.day_is_closed_warning: This day is closed — it cannot be edited until it is reopened.
accounting.gross_note: These sales are before bill discounts — a discount is agreed on the whole bill at the till, so there is no honest way to push it onto one product. Service charges are not products and are not counted here.
accounting.drawer_should_have_now: Should be in the drawer now
accounting.drawer_should_have_end: Should have been in the drawer at the end of the day
accounting.drawer_should_have_at_close: Should have been in the drawer at closing
accounting.drawer_cash_only: Cash only — card sales never go into the drawer.
accounting.drawer_start_hint: The fixed amount left in the drawer every night
accounting.drawer_out: Went out of the drawer today
accounting.drawer_out_manual: Money taken out of the drawer
accounting.drawer_actions_title: Something happened with the drawer? Record it here
accounting.drawer_took_out_hint: e.g. a withdrawal, a customer refund
accounting.drawer_absence_hint: Comes off pay, doesn't touch the drawer
accounting.drawer_locked_note: This day is closed and can't be added to. To fix a mistake, reopen it from the closing section.
accounting.drawer_close_intro: At the end of the shift: count the cash in the drawer and type the amount. You'll see straight away whether it matches.
accounting.drawer_step_count: Count all the cash in the drawer — how much is there?
accounting.drawer_result_exact: Spot on! The drawer matches exactly
accounting.drawer_recount: Count again to be sure. If the gap is still the same, note the reason below if you know it.
accounting.drawer_take_leave: After closing: take {take} out of the drawer and leave {leave} as change for tomorrow.
accounting.drawer_leave_all: After closing: leave it all in the drawer — it is less than tomorrow's change ({leave}).
accounting.drawer_confirm_short: The drawer is short by {amount}. Close the day anyway?
accounting.drawer_confirm_over: The drawer is over by {amount}. Close the day anyway?
accounting.drawer_closed_short: Day closed — the drawer was short by {amount}
accounting.drawer_closed_over: Day closed — the drawer was over by {amount}
accounting.drawer_reopen: Reopen the day (to fix a mistake)
accounting.drawer_info_title: Just so you know — these don't change what's in the drawer
accounting.drawer_card_hint: Goes to the bank, not the drawer
accounting.drawer_discounts_hint: The customer paid less than the full price
accounting.drawer_staff_deductions_hint: Taken off their pay at the end of the month
accounting.drawer_log_title: Everything that happened in the drawer
accounting.drawer_log_empty: Nothing happened in the drawer on this day.
accounting.drawer_type_collection_hint: e.g. a debt paid back, money from the owner
accounting.drawer_type_float_hint: Coins and small notes for giving change
accounting.drawer_type_withdrawal_hint: e.g. the owner took some money
accounting.drawer_type_refund_hint: Gave a customer back part of their bill
accounting.takeaway_note: Orders with no table (takeaway / counter): {n}, worth {amount} — not part of the table ranking.
accounting.tables_note: One use = one paid bill at that table. The stay runs from the bill being opened to it being paid. Tables nobody sat at are listed at the bottom.
